returnWindowDays.description: How many days after delivery a return/damage claim may still be considered.

returnRefundPercentCeiling.description: A plain return's cumulative total, as a percent of the order's own value, above which it needs human review. >=100 together with returnRefundCeiling<=0 means no dollar cap at all.

returnRefundCeiling.description: A plain return's cumulative dollar total above which it needs human review, in the account's own currency.

requestDamagedItemReturn.description: When a rep approves a damage/fault claim, whether the "ask the customer to send the item back" box starts ticked. Only a request — the refund still goes out right away, and the rep can change it on each case.

damagedItemReturnThreshold.description: Damage claims below this amount start with that box unticked — a cheap item usually isn't worth shipping back.

autonomousRefundsEnabled.description: Master switch for decisions made without a rep. Off: every refund, return and dispute goes to a rep, including automatic denials.

autonomousPlainReturnsEnabled.description: Whether a plain return can be approved automatically at all. Off: every plain return goes to a rep.

deliveryDisputesAlwaysEscalate.description: Delivery disputes always go to a rep — the carrier record and the customer's account disagree, and nothing can be verified from here. Turn off only alongside rules that decide disputes on their own.

facts.name: returnCumulativeAmount
facts.description: What this order's total refunded-or-pending amount would become if this request were approved: already refunded on this order + any other open case's pending amount + this request.

facts.name: returnPercentOfOrder
facts.description: returnCumulativeAmount as a percent of the order's own total value.

rules.description: Delivery disputes always go to a rep (deliveryDisputesAlwaysEscalate).

outcome.explanation: Carrier record and customer account of events disagree — investigate with the carrier before any refund or reship; do not act on the claim alone.
outcome.customerReason: A specialist will investigate this with the shipping carrier and follow up with you.

rules.description: An order may be refunded or returned only once, however many items are on it. Any approved refund on the order (of any kind) or any other open case counts; the current request does not count against itself.

outcome.explanation: This order already has an approved refund or another open case — an order may only be refunded or returned once, so a person needs to decide.
outcome.customerReason: This order already has a refund or return in progress, so a specialist needs to review this request.

rules.description: Fault attribution wasn't provided at all — escalate rather than assume either party is at fault.

outcome.explanation: Fault attribution wasn't provided — escalating rather than assuming either party is at fault.
outcome.customerReason: We need a specialist to take a closer look at this one.

rules.description: Not the customer's fault, but delivered too long ago for the standard return window.

outcome.explanation: Delivered past the return window — policy requires escalation regardless of amount or fault.
outcome.customerReason: This is outside our standard return window, so a specialist needs to take a look.

rules.description: Not the customer's fault, within the window — always needs a human to review photo evidence and confirm fault; there's no automated verification for this claim type.

outcome.explanation: Damage attributed to the product, not the customer — a specialist needs to review the photo evidence to confirm fault before a refund can be approved.
outcome.customerReason: This needs a specialist to review the photo evidence before we can proceed.

rules.description: The customer's own fault, but the account is VIP — escalate for a full refund anyway, as a courtesy. Not window-gated, unlike the not-their-fault branch above.

outcome.explanation: Damage attributed to the customer, but the account is VIP — policy requires escalating for a full refund regardless of amount, as a customer courtesy.
outcome.customerReason: A specialist will take a look and follow up with you.

rules.description: Delivered too long ago for the standard return window.

outcome.explanation: Past the standard return window — needs a human decision.
outcome.customerReason: This is outside our standard return window, so a specialist needs to take a look.

rules.description: Autonomous return refunds are turned off — either the percent ceiling is at/below zero, or the dollar ceiling is at/below zero without the deliberate 100%/0 'no dollar cap' combination.

outcome.explanation: Autonomous return refunds are turned off — every plain return needs a human decision.
outcome.customerReason: Returns currently need a quick review from our team before they're processed.

rules.description: Cumulative total (already refunded on this order, plus any other pending case, plus this request) exceeds the percent-of-order ceiling, or exceeds the flat dollar ceiling (unless the deliberate 100%/0 'no dollar cap' combination is active).

outcome.explanation: Requested refund would bring this order's cumulative total over the configured ceiling — needs a human decision.
outcome.customerReason: This return is larger than what we can approve automatically, so a specialist needs to take a look.

rules.description: Decisions without a rep are switched off (autonomousRefundsEnabled) — every refund, return and dispute goes to a person.

outcome.explanation: Decisions without a rep are switched off in policy — this needs a human decision.
outcome.customerReason: A specialist will take a look and follow up with you.

rules.description: Automatic approval of plain returns is switched off (autonomousPlainReturnsEnabled).

outcome.explanation: Automatic approval of plain returns is switched off in policy — every plain return needs a human decision.
outcome.customerReason: Returns currently need a quick review from our team before they're processed.

rules.description: A delivery dispute is never decided automatically: the carrier record and the customer's account disagree and nothing can be verified from here.

outcome.explanation: Carrier record and customer account of events disagree — investigate with the carrier before any refund or reship; do not act on the claim alone.
outcome.customerReason: A specialist will investigate this with the shipping carrier and follow up with you.

rules.description: The damage is the customer's own fault and the account is not VIP — a polite automatic refusal. (Unknown fault and VIP customers are restrictions above, so they never reach this.)

outcome.explanation: Damage attributed to the customer, and the account is not VIP — policy specifies an autonomous, polite rejection; no human review needed.
outcome.customerReason: We're sorry, but we're not able to offer a refund for this — the damage isn't related to a manufacturing defect or shipping issue, so it falls outside what we can cover.

rules.description: A plain return that no restriction above blocked — delivered within the window, inside both ceilings — is approved automatically.

outcome.explanation: Within the return window and both configured ceilings.

fallback.explanation: No rule authorizes an automatic outcome for this request — a person needs to decide.
fallback.customerReason: A specialist will take a look and follow up with you.
